items.exampleEn: She bought a bottle of perfume at the airport.
items.exampleZh: 她在機場買了一瓶香水。

items.exampleEn: My suitcase is overweight, so I have to pay more.
items.exampleZh: 我的行李箱超重了，所以得多付錢。

items.exampleEn: The girl with blonde hair is my cousin.
items.exampleZh: 那個金髮女孩是我表妹。

items.exampleEn: These silver earrings were a gift from my mother.
items.exampleZh: 這對銀耳環是我媽媽送的禮物。

items.exampleEn: He never goes out without his sunglasses.
items.exampleZh: 他出門一定會戴太陽眼鏡。
這瓶洗髮精聞起來有蘋果的味道。

items.sentenceEn: I left my sunglasses in the car.
items.sentenceZh: 我把太陽眼鏡忘在車上了。

items.audioEn: My bag is overweight. I need to take some things out.
items.audioZh: 我的包包超重了，我得拿一些東西出來。
items.questionZh: 說話的人的包包有什麼問題？

items.sentenceEn: Her blonde hair looks great in the sun.
items.sentenceZh: 她的金髮在陽光下很好看。

items.stemEn: It's very sunny. Put on your ____.
items.stemZh: 太陽很大，戴上你的太陽眼鏡吧。

items.stemEn: She wears a little ____ when she goes out. It smells nice.
items.stemZh: 她出門時會擦一點香水，聞起來很香。

items.passageEn: Before her trip to Japan, Amy went shopping. She bought new sunglasses, a pair of gold earrings and three bottles of perfume. At the airport, her suitcase was overweight, so she had to pay more money. "Maybe I didn't need so much perfume," she said and laughed. In Japan, she stayed with a host family and gave them one bottle.
items.passageZh: 去日本旅行之前，Amy 去購物。她買了一副新的太陽眼鏡、一對金耳環和三瓶香水。到了機場，她的行李箱超重，只好多付錢。她笑著說：「也許我不需要那麼多香水。」在日本，她住在寄宿家庭，還送了他們一瓶。

options: 她把新的太陽眼鏡弄丟了

questions.questionZh: Amy 把一瓶香水送給了誰？

items.promptZh: 這家店有賣襪子和胸罩。
referenceEn: This shop sells socks and bras.
This store sells socks and bras.
rubricZh: 「胸罩」用 bra，泛指商品時用複數 bras
主詞是單數的店，動詞要加 s（例如 sells）；寫 You can buy socks and bras here 也正確

referenceEn: Who do these sunglasses belong to?
rubricZh: sunglasses 是複數，代名詞與動詞配合複數（例如 these、are、do 等）
「是誰的」可寫，例如 Whose sunglasses are these?、Whose are these sunglasses?、belong to 等
